    f: F,
) -> (res: U)

pub assume_specification<'a, T, F: FnMut(&'a T) -> Ordering>[ <[T]>::binary_search_by ](
    slice: &'a [T],
    f: F,
) -> (result: Result<usize, usize>)
    requires
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < slice@.len() ==> f.requires((&slice@[i],)),
    ensures
        slice.len() == 0 ==> result == Result::<usize, usize>::Err(0),
        result is Ok ==> {
            &&& result->Ok_0 < slice.len()
            &&& f.ensures((&slice@[result->Ok_0 as int],), Ordering::Equal)
        },
        result is Err ==> result->Err_0 <= slice.len(),
;
ensures: result is Ok ==> result->Ok_0 < slice.len() && f.ensures((&slice@[result->Ok_0 as int],), Ordering::Equal)

risks: Precision depends on the supplied FnMut contract.
Insertion-order semantics require an additional comparator-consistency abstraction.
